options.A: Engine cooling system
options.B: Cooling capacity of oil
options.C: Battery

explanation: Cold rating (Cold Cranking Amperes - CCA) is a battery performance specification defined by SAE as the discharge current in amperes that a fully charged lead-acid battery can deliver continuously for 30 seconds at 0°F (-17.8°C) while maintaining terminal voltage above 7.2 V.

subject: AMVI
question: Frictional power is:

options.A: BP+FP.
options.B: IP-BP.
options.C: IP+FP.

explanation: Frictional Power (FP) is the mechanical power lost within the engine due to friction between moving parts, pumping losses, and driving accessories. It is defined as: FP = IP - BP (Indicated Power minus Brake Power).

subject: AMVI
question: Cold starting device:

options.A: Heater plugs
options.B: Chemical spray
options.C: Manifold heaters

explanation: Cold starting auxiliary devices for diesel engines include glow plugs (heater plugs) inside the pre-combustion chamber, ether-based chemical starting sprays, and electric intake manifold air heaters / grid heaters.

subject: AMVI
question: What is the motto of National Games ?

options.A: Deeper integration for peace and prosperity
options.B: Get set play
options.C: Faster, Higher, Stronger

explanation: The official motto of the National Games of India is 'Get Set Play' (invoking athletic preparation and spirit).

subject: AMVI
question: Highest useful compression ratio is the compression ratio at which the engine:

options.A: Gives maximum power output
options.B: Can operate without detonation
options.C: Maintains operating pressures and temperatures within the prescribed limits
options.D: Consumes minimum fuel for a particular power output

explanation: Highest Useful Compression Ratio (HUCR) is defined as the maximum compression ratio at which a spark-ignition engine can operate under specified conditions on a given fuel without the occurrence of detonation (knocking).

subject: AMVI
question: New generation car headlamp does not need black spot painted on its glass:

options.A: It has two filaments.
options.B: Filaments are accurately positioned in particular angle inside the bulb
options.C: Reflector is specially designed
options.D: Wattage of bulb is very low

explanation: New-generation vehicle headlamps utilize computer-designed complex shape / free-form (multi-focal) reflectors and clear polycarbonate lenses that precisely focus and direct the light beam onto the road without requiring bulb shields or black glare spots on the outer glass.

subject: AMVI
question: The efficiency of a boiler plant ............ with mechanical draught :

options.A: increases
options.B: remains same
options.C: decreases

explanation: Employing mechanical (forced or induced) draught increases overall boiler efficiency by ensuring higher air delivery rates, enabling thicker fuel beds, allowing installation of waste-heat economizers and air preheaters, and eliminating dependence on atmospheric temperature.

subject: AMVI
question: The most efficient air standard cycle is :

options.A: Carnot cycle
options.B: Otto cycle
options.C: Diesel cycle

explanation: Carnot's theorem establishes that the Carnot cycle is the most efficient theoretical thermodynamic cycle possible operating between two given temperature reservoirs; no practical engine cycle can exceed its thermal efficiency.

subject: AMVI
question: Compared to cross ply tyre the radial ply tyre has the disadvantage of:

options.A: Smaller slip angles
options.B: Lower rolling resistance
options.C: High cornering power

explanation: Radial-ply tyres have flexible sidewalls backed by rigid steel/fabric breaker belts under the tread. At low speeds, the stiff belt transmits minor road impacts directly into the chassis, resulting in a somewhat harsher and uncomfortable ride at low speeds compared to cross-ply tyres.

subject: AMVI
question: Factors relating to wheel alignment:

options.A: Steering geometry
options.B: Inflation of tyres
options.C: Balancing of wheels

explanation: Wheel alignment involves the interrelated setup of front steering geometry (camber, castor, kingpin inclination, toe-in/toe-out), proper tyre inflation pressure, and dynamic balancing of road wheels to ensure directional stability and minimize tyre wear.

subject: AMVI
question: In an air brake system when the brake pedal is freed to deactivate the brakes, the high pressure air form the lines is released to the through the:

options.A: Unloader valve
options.B: Breather hole in the brake chamber
options.C: Fluid check valve in the reservoir
options.D: Exhaust port in the brake valve

explanation: In a commercial vehicle air brake system, releasing the foot brake pedal moves the brake dual-control valve to its exhaust position, opening the internal exhaust port and venting compressed air from the brake lines and brake chambers directly to the atmosphere.

subject: AMVI
question: The components of an automobile transmission system that facilitate the drive to turn at right angle are:

options.A: Planet pinion and sun gear
options.B: Bevel pinion and sun gear
options.C: Crown wheel and sun gear

explanation: In an automotive rear-wheel-drive live axle, the bevel pinion and crown wheel together form the final drive, which turns the rotary drive through a 90-degree right angle from the longitudinal propeller shaft to the transverse axle shafts.

subject: AMVI
question: Which of the following enters to the super heater of a boiler ?

options.A: Hot water
options.B: Super heated steam
options.C: Wet steam

explanation: In a steam boiler plant, wet/saturated steam discharged from the boiler drum enters the superheater tubes, where it absorbs additional sensible heat from hot flue gases to become dry superheated steam at constant pressure.

subject: AMVI
question: Torque transfer at an angle is provided on propeller shaft by using :

options.A: Centre support bearing
options.B: Slip joint
options.C: Universal joint

explanation: A universal joint (Hooke's joint or cardan joint) is fitted at the ends of the automotive propeller shaft to transmit driving torque smoothly across the variable operating angles caused by vertical suspension deflections of the rear live axle.

subject: AMVI
question: Removal of burned mixture using slightly compressed charge is:

options.A: Super charging
options.B: Scavenging
options.C: Blow bye

explanation: Scavenging is the process of expelling the residual burned exhaust gases from the engine cylinder by forcing in a fresh slightly pressurized charge of air (in diesel engines) or air-fuel mixture (in two-stroke petrol engines) through the intake ports.

subject: AMVI
question: Observer say the object is above horizontal plane and in front of vertical plane the object is in which quardrant:

options.A: I

explanation: In engineering orthographic projection geometry: an object situated above the horizontal reference plane (HP) and in front of the vertical reference plane (VP) lies in the First (1st) Quadrant.

subject: AMVI
question: Solid lubricant is:

options.A: Molybdenum
options.B: Graphite
options.C: Copper

explanation: Graphite is a classic solid lubricant having a layered hexagonal crystalline lattice structure that shears easily under load, providing low friction and remaining stable at high operating temperatures where liquid oils burn off.

subject: AMVI
question: Engine lubricating oil pump is usually driven by a:

options.A: Crankshaft pulley
options.B: Camshaft gear
options.C: Lay'shaft gear

explanation: In a conventional automotive engine with a block-mounted camshaft, the engine lubricating oil pump and ignition distributor are driven together by a spiral (helical) skew gear machined directly on the camshaft.

subject: AMVI
question: Reboring of an engine cylinder to the next oversize would slightly:

options.A: Increase the stroke length
options.B: Increase the stroke volume
options.C: Decrease the compression ratio

explanation: Reboring an engine cylinder increases the cylinder bore diameter D. Since swept (stroke) volume Vs = (pi / 4) * D^2 * L, reboring to the next oversize directly increases the swept stroke volume of the cylinder.

subject: AMVI
question: Which component is made from aluminium alloy?

options.A: Piston rings
options.B: Piston
options.C: Gudgeon pin

explanation: Automotive pistons are predominantly cast or forged from aluminium alloys (e.g. aluminium-silicon alloys like Lo-Ex) due to their low density, light weight, and high thermal conductivity. Piston rings are made of alloy cast iron, gudgeon pins of case-hardened alloy steel, and crankshafts of forged carbon/alloy steel or spheroidal graphite cast iron.

subject: AMVI
question: Hydraulic valve lifters are:

options.A: Noisy in operation
options.B: Provide zero valve tappet clearance
options.C: provide very high valve tappet clearance

explanation: Hydraulic valve lifters (lash adjusters) use pressurized engine lubricating oil inside an internal plunger mechanism to automatically compensate for thermal expansion, maintaining zero valve tappet clearance (zero lash) throughout engine operation, ensuring silent and maintenance-free valve actuation.

subject: AMVI
question: The ratio of strength of solid to hollow shaft, both having outside diameter D and hollow having inside diameter D/2 in torsion is :
explanation: Torsional strength of a shaft is proportional to its polar section modulus Zp. For solid shaft: Zp_s = (pi/16)*D^3. For hollow shaft with d = D/2: Zp_h = (pi/16)*(D^4 - (D/2)^4)/D = (pi/16)*D^3*(1 - 1/16) = (15/16)*Zp_s. Thus, the ratio of strength of the hollow shaft to the solid shaft is 15/16.

subject: AMVI
question: The time for half amount of radio active isotope to decay is known as :

options.A: Half life
options.B: Radio active decay
options.C: Rate of decay

explanation: In nuclear physics, the half-life (t_1/2) is the time required for one-half of the radioactive atomic nuclei of a given radioactive isotope to undergo spontaneous radioactive decay into another nuclear species.

subject: AMVI
question: The part of an overhead valve mechanism arranged between the valve tappet and rocker arm is:

options.A: Pull rod
options.B: Push rod
options.C: Tie rod

explanation: In an overhead valve (OHV) pushrod engine, the push rod is the slender steel/alloy rod positioned between the valve tappet (cam follower) riding on the camshaft and the rocker arm on the cylinder head.

subject: AMVI
question: The steering geometry that aids directional stability is:

options.A: King pin inclination
options.B: Toe-out
options.C: Positive camber

explanation: Positive castor (tilting the kingpin or steering pivot axis backward from the vertical when viewed from the side) creates a self-aligning torque that gives directional stability, helping the vehicle maintain a straight path and automatically return the wheels to straight-ahead after turning.

subject: AMVI
question: C.R.D.I is related to :

options.A: Ignition system
options.B: Fuel system
options.C: Lighting system

explanation: C.R.D.I. stands for Common Rail Direct Injection, which is an advanced electronic fuel delivery system used in modern compression-ignition (diesel) engines.

subject: AMVI
question: The distance between the centre lines of the front and the rear axles is called :

options.A: Axle distance
options.B: Effective chasis length
options.C: Wheel base

explanation: Wheelbase is the longitudinal horizontal distance between the center lines of the vehicle's front and rear road axles.

subject: AMVI
question: Which one of the followings is not a thermodynamic property?

options.A: Entropy
options.B: Pressure
options.C: Volume

explanation: Pressure, Volume, and Entropy are point functions that depend solely on the thermodynamic state of the system, making them thermodynamic properties. Heat and Work are energy in transit across boundaries and are path functions, not thermodynamic properties.

subject: AMVI
question: The property of a material which allows it to be drawn into smaller section is called :

options.A: Plasticity
options.B: ductility
options.C: elasticity

explanation: Ductility is the property of a solid material that enables it to be drawn or elongated into a smaller cross-section (such as fine wire) by tensile plastic deformation without fracturing.

subject: AMVI
question: Opening of inlet valve before TDC in suction stroke is called;

options.A: Valve lag
options.B: Valve overlap
options.C: Valve lead

explanation: In an engine valve timing diagram, the opening of the inlet valve a few degrees of crankshaft rotation before Top Dead Center (TDC) on the suction stroke is called 'Valve Lead'.

subject: AMVI
question: Ductility is the property of metal:

options.A: It can be drawn into sheets
options.B: It can be made springs
options.C: It can be heat treated
options.D: It can be drawn into wires

explanation: Ductility is the mechanical property of a material that enables it to undergo significant plastic deformation under tensile stress before fracture, allowing it to be drawn into thin wires. (Malleability allows it to be hammered into sheets).

subject: AMVI
question: Estimation in:

options.A: Pre-determination of cost of work
options.B: Post -determination of cost of work
options.C: Submission of tenders

explanation: Estimation in engineering and automotive servicing is the pre-determination (advance calculation) of the probable cost of materials, labour, machine time, and overheads required to carry out a specific repair or fabrication job before work begins.

subject: AMVI
question: In carburettors, compensating devices are used to provide:

options.A: A rich mixture in small quantity during idling
options.B: A lean mixture at higher altitudes
options.C: Correct proportions of fuel air mixture at all speeds
options.D: Chemically correct fuel a mixture at all engine operating conditions

explanation: Compensating devices in carburettors (such as compensating jets, air bleed orifices, or emulsion tubes) counteract the natural tendency of a simple fuel nozzle to deliver an overly rich mixture at high airflow rates, thereby maintaining correct air-fuel proportions across all engine operating speeds.

subject: AMVI
question: Purpose of double-de-clutching when selecting low gears in constant mesh gear box.

options.A: Slow down clutch shaft
options.B: Slow down main shaft
options.C: Speed up lay shaft

explanation: In a constant-mesh gearbox without synchromesh units, selecting lower gears requires double-declutching: when downshifting, the pedal is released in neutral and the throttle is blipped (accelerated), which speeds up the layshaft and clutch shaft so their gear peripheral speeds match the faster-turning mainshaft gear.

subject: AMVI
question: The object of producing the draught in boiler :

options.A: to provide the adequate supply of air for the combustion
options.B: to exhaust the gases of combustion from the combustion chamber
options.C: to discharge gases of combustion to the atmosphere

explanation: The purpose of producing boiler draught (natural or artificial) is: (1) to supply the required quantity of combustion air, (2) to draw hot flue gases through the boiler tubes, superheaters, and economizers, and (3) to discharge exhaust gases to the atmosphere through the chimney.

subject: AMVI
question: Which is not the advantage of low aspect ratio tyres?

options.A: Comfortable ride
options.B: Better load carrying capacity
options.C: Less wear

explanation: Low aspect ratio (low-profile) tyres have very short, stiff sidewalls. While they provide excellent cornering power, superior braking grip, and high stability, the reduced sidewall cushioning makes the vehicle ride harsher and less comfortable over bumpy roads.

subject: AMVI
question: In a Diesel cycle, heat rejection takes place at:

options.A: Constant volume
options.B: Constant pressure
options.C: Constant temperature

explanation: In the ideal Diesel cycle, heat addition from fuel combustion takes place at constant pressure (2-3), while heat rejection to the exhaust takes place at constant volume (4-1).

subject: AMVI
question: Schrader valve appears on :

options.A: Master cylinder
options.B: Wheel cylinder
options.C: Wheel assembly

explanation: The Schrader valve is the spring-loaded pneumatic non-return air valve mechanism universally mounted on automotive wheel assemblies (tyres and tubes) used for inflating tyres with compressed air and measuring tyre inflation pressure.

subject: AMVI
question: The voltage regulator in the combined voltage and current regulator of a d.c charging circuit contains:

options.A: Shunt winding
options.B: Series winding
options.C: Shunt or series winding

explanation: In the three-unit electromechanical regulator of a DC charging circuit, the voltage regulator unit contains a fine wire coil connected in shunt (parallel) across the generator output terminals to sense system voltage.

subject: AMVI
question: A loose fit between a dry cylinder liner and cylinder block would cause:

options.A: Hot spots
options.B: High operating temperatures
options.C: Distortion of cylinder block

explanation: A dry cylinder liner relies on close metal-to-metal contact with the cylinder block bore to conduct heat away to the cooling water jacket. A loose fit creates an air gap with very poor thermal conductivity, causing localized overheating and 'hot spots' on the cylinder wall.

subject: AMVI
question: A Hook's joint in an automobile transmission system is preferred when the driving and driven shafts are:

options.A: Parallel and non-intersecting
options.B: Parallel and intersecting
options.C: Non-parallel and intersecting

explanation: A Hooke's joint (universal joint) in an automobile transmission connects two shafts whose axes are non-parallel and intersect at a variable angle, such as the propeller shaft connecting the gearbox to the rear axle.

subject: AMVI
question: Car can stop in gear by using :

options.A: Vacuum clutch
options.B: Cone clutch
options.C: Multi plate clutch

explanation: A vehicle equipped with a fluid flywheel (fluid coupling) can be brought to a complete stop with the transmission gear engaged without stalling the engine, because at low engine idle speeds the kinetic energy of fluid circulation is insufficient to overcome resting vehicle inertia.

subject: AMVI
question: Part of ignition system which transform the voltage from 12 V to 16000 V.

options.A: Ignition coil
options.B: Capacitor
options.C: Spark plug

explanation: The ignition coil is a pulse step-up autotransformer that steps up the 12-volt DC battery voltage to high secondary voltages (typically 15,000 V to 25,000 V) required to ionize the spark plug gap and produce an electric ignition spark across the electrodes.

subject: AMVI
question: The characteristic equation of gas is :

options.A: R_U = mR
options.B: h = U + pv
options.C: pv = mRT

explanation: The characteristic gas equation for an ideal gas of mass m is derived from Boyle's and Charles's laws as: p * V = m * R * T, where p is absolute pressure, V is volume, R is the specific gas constant, and T is absolute temperature.

subject: AMVI
question: As per the Motor Vehicle Act 1988, the maximum speed limit for motor cycle is:

options.A: 45 km/hr
options.B: 50 km/hr
options.C: 55 km/hr

explanation: Under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 and State Traffic Rules, the maximum statutory speed limit originally stipulated for motorcycles was 50 km/hr (later upgraded in subsequent notifications to 60/70 km/h).

subject: AMVI
question: M. A. C. T. is related to :

options.A: Fitness test
options.B: Accident claim
options.C: Learners test

explanation: M.A.C.T. stands for Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, a specialized judicial tribunal established under Section 165 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 for adjudicating claims of compensation regarding death, bodily injury, or property damage arising out of motor vehicle accidents.

subject: AMVI
question: The functional design of an automobile deals with

options.A: Size of the vehicle
options.B: Stress involved in members
options.C: Get up styling for the utility purpose

explanation: The functional design of an automobile is concerned with tailoring the body styling, interior ergonomics, packaging, and layout to ensure the vehicle efficiently serves its intended practical utility purpose (e.g. taxi, ambulance, delivery van).

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Failure of leaf spring occur due to :

options.A: Strength
options.B: Fatigue
options.C: Elasticity

explanation: Leaf springs are subjected to repeated dynamic cyclic loading and fluctuating road shocks, causing progressive structural micro-cracks and eventual failure due to fatigue stress.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Aspect ratio of a tyre is the ratio between :

options.A: Height to width
options.B: Height to plies
options.C: Plies to Bead

explanation: Tyre aspect ratio (profile) is defined as the percentage ratio of the section height of the tyre to its cross-sectional width (Aspect Ratio = Height / Width × 100).

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: One of the following is considered as working stroke :

options.A: Suction
options.B: Compression
options.C: Power

explanation: The power (expansion) stroke is the only stroke in an internal combustion engine that produces positive mechanical work by expanding burning gases against the piston.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Lonenging stress causes :

options.A: Forcing rectangular frame into diamond shape
options.B: Bending stress resulting from rising and falling of both axles
options.C: Stress acting on frame due to acceleration
options.D: Stress acting on frame due to braking

explanation: Lozenging (or diamonding) occurs when opposite sides of a vehicle chassis frame experience opposing longitudinal forces, distorting the rectangular frame into a parallelogram or diamond shape.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: First Automobile factory in India :

options.A: Premier Automobiles Mumbai
options.B: Maruti Udyog Ltd. Haryana
options.C: TATA Motors Mumbai

explanation: Hindustan Motors was established in 1942 at Port Okha and later established its integrated manufacturing plant at Uttarpara near Calcutta (Kolkata) in 1948, making it India's first automobile factory.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Grommet is :

options.A: Other name gudgeon pin
options.B: Rubber sleeve fitted to a cable where it passes through bulkhead, to protect the cable from chafing
options.C: Grinding of valve seat and face for fine seating

explanation: A grommet is an elastomeric rubber sleeve or ring fitted into a bulkhead or body panel opening to insulate and protect wiring cables from sharp edges and mechanical chafing.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Effect of Ackermans steering principle is that :

options.A: During turns outer wheel is pivoted through a greater angle than the inner
options.B: Car wheel is tilted from vertical
options.C: During turns inner wheel is pivoted through a greater angle than the outer

explanation: According to the Ackerman steering principle, because the inner front wheel turns along a smaller turning radius during cornering, it pivots through a greater angle than the outer wheel to eliminate tyre scrub.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Anodised Aluminium is used for making :

options.A: Gudgeon Pin
options.B: Crank shaft
options.C: Cam shaft

explanation: Anodized aluminium provides high corrosion resistance, light weight, and decorative luster, making it widely used for automotive front radiator grilles and exterior body trims.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Effect of Aligning torque is :

options.A: Tendency of tyre to return to straight ahead position after steering
options.B: Torque applied to wheels to tight wheel nuts
options.C: Torque reaction taken by torque tube

explanation: Self-aligning torque (SAT) is generated by tyre cornering forces acting behind the contact patch centre (pneumatic trail), producing a restoring torque that returns wheels to the straight-ahead position.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: What is American Fine ?

options.A: U.S. system of defining file teeth
options.B: U.S. based company producing cooling fins
options.C: U.S. system of defining screw threads

explanation: American Fine (Unified National Fine - UNF / SAE) is the American standardized thread pitch system for fine screw threads widely used on automotive fasteners.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Annulus of an epicyclic gear train means :

options.A: Name given to sun gear
options.B: Name of internally toothed outer ring
options.C: Name of the planet gear
options.D: Name of Rack and Pinion assembly

explanation: In an epicyclic (planetary) gear train, the annulus (or ring gear) is the outer coaxial gear with internal gear teeth that mesh with the planet gears.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: CRDI means :

options.A: Common Rod Direct Injection
options.B: Continuously Rotating Direct Injection
options.C: Car Rear Double Injection

explanation: CRDI stands for Common Rail Direct Injection, where high-pressure diesel fuel is stored in a common rail and injected directly into cylinders via electronic injectors.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Aqua Planning is :

options.A: Behaviour of tyre in very warm atmospheric conditions
options.B: Condition in which tyre looses its grip and skates over water on road surface
options.C: Extra grip fitted on surface of the tyre

explanation: Aquaplaning (hydroplaning) occurs when a layer of water builds up between tyre treads and wet pavement, causing loss of traction and making the vehicle skate uncontrollably over water.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Axle ratio is the ratio between :

options.A: RPM of propeller shaft to RPM of clutch shaft
options.B: RPM of gear box input shaft to RPM of output shaft
options.C: RPM of propeller shaft to RPM of driven wheels
options.D: RPM of Rear axle to RPM of Front axle

explanation: The final drive (axle) ratio is the gear reduction ratio between the rotational speed of the propeller shaft (drive pinion) and the driven road wheels (crown wheel/differential).

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Back flushing is the process of :

options.A: Cleaning cooling system pumping water in reverse direction of normal flow
options.B: Cleaning cooling system by pumping water in same direction of normal flow
options.C: Cleaning cooling system by using special chemicals

explanation: Back flushing cleans automotive cooling systems by forcing water and flushing chemicals in the reverse direction of normal coolant circulation to dislodge trapped rust and scale.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: An operation out of the following cannot be performed on a lathe :

options.A: Facing
options.B: Thread cutting
options.C: Drilling

explanation: Slotting requires reciprocating linear vertical tool movement performed on a slotter or shaper machine, whereas a lathe is designed for rotary turning, facing, drilling, and thread cutting.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The refrigerant used in domestic refrigerator is :

options.A: Sulphur dioxide
options.B: Carbon Monoxide
options.C: Air

explanation: Freon (halocarbon refrigerants like R-12, R-134a) has traditionally been the primary working fluid in domestic vapor-compression refrigeration systems.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The Diesel cycle operates on / is also known as :

options.A: Constant Pressure Cycle
options.B: Carnot Cycle
options.C: Constant Volume Cycle

explanation: The Diesel cycle is known as the Constant Pressure Cycle because heat addition from fuel combustion takes place at constant pressure during the initial expansion stroke.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: A four cylinder four stroke diesel engine has 3000 power strokes per minute altogether in the engine speed in RPM of engine is :
explanation: In a 4-stroke engine, each cylinder produces 1 power stroke every 2 crankshaft revolutions. Total power strokes per minute = 4 × (N / 2) = 2N. Given 2N = 3000, engine speed N = 3000 / 2 = 1500 RPM.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In a flange coupling the flange bolts are designed for :

options.A: Shear force
options.B: Compression
options.C: Fatigue

explanation: The bolts in a rigid flange coupling transmit power by resisting circumferential shearing stresses across the mating flange interface.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In a simple spur gear train gear teeth with 24, 48, 32, 72 are in sequence. The gear with 24 teeth run at 1200 rpm. The speed of gear teeth with 72 teeth in rpm is :
explanation: In a simple spur gear train, intermediate gears act as idlers. Speed ratio depends strictly on driver and driven: N1 × T1 = N4 × T4 => 1200 × 24 = N4 × 72 => N4 = (1200 × 24) / 72 = 400 RPM.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: IPAS is :

options.A: Integrated Power Assisted Symbol
options.B: Intelligent Power Assisted Steering
options.C: Internal Power And Steering

explanation: IPAS stands for Intelligent Power Assisted Steering (or Intelligent Parking Assist System), an electronically modulated power steering technology.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: During valve overlap :

options.A: Both inlet and exhaust valve remain open
options.B: Both inlet and exhaust valve remain closed
options.C: Inlet valve opens early and close late

explanation: Valve overlap is the brief crank angle duration near TDC between exhaust and suction strokes where both the intake and exhaust valves are simultaneously open to improve scavenging.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The shape of reflector used for Automobile head lamp is :

options.A: Spherical
options.B: Hyperbolic
options.C: Parabolic

explanation: Automobile headlamps use parabolic reflectors because placing the bulb filament at the geometric focal point reflects light rays into a focused, parallel forward beam.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The braking wheels get locked before the vehicle stops the vehicle is said to be :

options.A: Slipping
options.B: Skidding
options.C: Rolling

explanation: When vehicle wheels lock up under extreme braking while the vehicle continues moving forward, the tyres slide along the road surface in a state known as skidding.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Growler test is conducted on :

options.A: Starting motor
options.B: Cut out relay
options.C: Battery

explanation: A growler is an electromagnetic inductive test instrument used by automotive electrical technicians to diagnose short-circuited and open windings in starter motor and generator armatures.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Ratio of braking effect at the front and rear wheels considering weight transfer during braking is :

options.A: 50 percent at front and 50 percent at rear
options.B: 40 percent at front and 60 percent at rear
options.C: 60 percent at front and 40 percent at rear

explanation: Forward dynamic inertia during deceleration transfers weight to the front axle, requiring an approximate 60% front and 40% rear braking ratio for optimal stopping stability.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: One of the following is not a reason for gear slipping :

options.A: Worn selector mechanism
options.B: Loose main shaft gears
options.C: Bearing worn out

explanation: A damaged oil seal causes lubricant leakage but does not cause gears to jump out of mesh; gear slipping is caused by worn selector forks, weakened detent springs, or excessive shaft end-play.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Firewall is :

options.A: Metal wall between engine and passenger compartment
options.B: Metal wall between engine and bonnet
options.C: Engine mounting seat

explanation: A firewall (bulkhead) is a heavy steel partition separating the engine compartment from the passenger cabin to block engine heat, noxious gases, noise, and fire.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Bias ply tyres have :

options.A: All plies running parallel to one another
options.B: Belt of steel mesh in the tyre
options.C: One ply layer runs diagonally one way and another layer runs diagonally other way

explanation: In bias-ply (cross-ply) tyre carcass construction, fabric cord plies run diagonally across the tyre from bead to bead in alternating criss-cross layers.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: When piston rings are installed upside down what will happen ?

options.A: Increased Oil Consumption
options.B: Increased Cylinder wall wear
options.C: Broken Lands

explanation: Taper-faced compression and scraper rings installed upside down act as pumps that force oil into the combustion chamber, resulting in severe oil burning and excessive consumption.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Gear provided in the centre of an epicyclic gear train is :

options.A: Ring Gear
options.B: Dog Gear
options.C: Sun Gear

explanation: In an epicyclic planetary gearset, the central gear located on the central shaft is the Sun gear, around which the planet gears orbit.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Tip Tronic Transmission allows :

options.A: Computer controlled clutch on manual transmission
options.B: Driver to override the automatic mode
options.C: Fully manual transmission and manual gear change

explanation: Tiptronic transmissions allow the driver to manually override automatic shift points using selector gates or steering wheel paddle shifters.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The purpose of heat control valve in some exhaust manifold is :

options.A: Preheat air so that engine will start easier
options.B: Help to start diesel engine
options.C: Improve fuel vapourization for better cold engine performance

explanation: A bimetallic heat control valve diverts hot exhaust gas to heat the intake manifold hot spot during cold starting, accelerating fuel vaporization and improving cold driveability.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Scuff wear is caused by :

options.A: Abrasive wear
options.B: Momentary weld at BDC
options.C: Excessive oil in combustion chamber

explanation: Scuff wear on cylinder liners and rings occurs under peak combustion temperatures and boundary lubrication failure near Top Dead Centre (TDC), causing microscopic welding and metal tearing.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The purpose of piston pin offset is :

options.A: Center the piston in cylinder
options.B: Prevent piston slip
options.C: Improve piston pin oiling

explanation: Piston pin offset (locating the wrist pin slightly off-centre toward the thrust side) causes the piston to tilt gradually before reaching TDC, minimizing audible piston slap against cylinder walls.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The shell bearing diameter is greater than the diameter of the bore onto which it is placed is called bearing :

options.A: Spread
options.B: Crush
options.C: Diameter

explanation: Bearing spread is the slight intentional oversize across the parting faces of a split half-shell bearing that holds it securely in its bore during installation.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: What is wet fouling of spark plug ?

options.A: Fouling due to oil entering the combustion chamber
options.B: Fouling due to carbon deposit
options.C: Fouling due to burned lead deposit

explanation: Wet fouling occurs when unburned engine lubricating oil leaks past worn piston rings or valve guides and coats spark plug electrodes with an oily conductive film that prevents spark generation.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Thickness gauge blade which has two thickness is called :

options.A: Wire gauge
options.B: Go no go gauge
options.C: Micrometer gauge

explanation: A stepped feeler gauge blade having two distinct thicknesses along its length is called a Go/No-Go thickness gauge, enabling fast tolerance gap verification.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Long loose sleeves of shirt around a moving machine could :

options.A: Protect your arms
options.B: Get caught in the machinery and injure you
options.C: Keep you clean

explanation: Loose clothing and sleeves around rotating workshop machinery present severe entanglement hazards that can draw limbs into rotating spindles and cause serious injury.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: To loosen a screw held with an aerobic sealant you should :

options.A: Hit the screw with a hammer
options.B: Spray oil onto sealant
options.C: Heat the sealant with soldering gun

explanation: Anaerobic threadlockers and adhesives degrade and soften at elevated temperatures (typically 200°C–250°C), making localized heating with a soldering iron or heat torch the standard release method.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Two types of snap rings are :

options.A: Threaded and Press fit
options.B: Compression and Oil control
options.C: Split and Solid

explanation: Snap rings (circlips) are manufactured in two basic configurations: internal snap rings (fitted into housing or cylinder bore grooves) and external snap rings (fitted over external shaft grooves).

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The purpose of cotter pin is :

options.A: Prevent nut from loosening
options.B: Fasten the cotter securely
options.C: Prevent the cotter from dropping off

explanation: A split cotter pin is inserted through a drilled hole in a bolt and the slots of a castellated nut to mechanically lock the nut from backing off under vibration.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: A Gasket is used :

options.A: Seal out dirt, water and air
options.B: Take up space
options.C: Seal in fuel oil or coolant

explanation: Gaskets provide compliant sealing between rigid mating surfaces to retain internal liquids/gases, compensate for surface irregularities, and prevent external contamination.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Three power tools used are :

options.A: Pneumatic; Air and Electric
options.B: Pneumatic, Hydraulic and Electric
options.C: Hydraulic; Electric; Torque Wrench

explanation: Power tools in automotive workshops are classified by their prime driving energy sources: pneumatic (compressed air), hydraulic (pressurized oil), and electric.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The overhead cam shaft engine is more responsive engine because :

options.A: This is a spark ignition engine
options.B: The Engine is smaller
options.C: The pistons are lighter
options.D: There are few parts in valve train

explanation: Overhead camshaft (OHC) engines eliminate pushrods and lifters, drastically reducing reciprocating valvetrain mass and inertia for quick throttle response and high-RPM stability.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In multiple displacement V-8 Engine electronic controls can cut out :

options.A: 1, 2, 3 or 4 cylinders
options.B: 2, 3 or 4 cylinders
options.C: All the cylinders

explanation: Electronic variable displacement systems in V8 engines (such as GM AFM or Chrysler MDS) selectively deactivate 2 or 4 cylinders during light cruising to maximize fuel economy.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The purpose of producing swirl in the combustion chamber is to :

options.A: Allow burned gases to exhaust freely
options.B: Permit more air fuel mixture to enter
options.C: Spread the flame more rapidly so that combustion is improved
options.D: Allow valve to open more evenly

explanation: Inducing swirl and turbulence in intake air accelerates air-fuel atomization and speeds up flame front propagation across the combustion chamber for efficient, complete combustion.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: When an engine is rebuilt :

options.A: The old piston rings should not be reinstalled
options.B: The old piston rings should be cleaned and reinstalled
options.C: Both (A) and (B)

explanation: Old piston rings wear to match the bore profile of the used cylinder and lose radial tension; during an overhaul, new piston rings must always be installed into freshly honed cylinders.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The output of diesel engine can be increased without increasing revolution or size by :

options.A: Increasing fly wheel size
options.B: Supercharging
options.C: Heating incoming air

explanation: Supercharging (or turbocharging) increases the density and mass of intake air forced into the cylinders, enabling more fuel to burn per stroke to boost power without increasing engine size or RPM.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Most high speed CI engines operates on following cycle :

options.A: Dual Combustion Cycle
options.B: Reverse Carnot Cycle
options.C: Diesel Cycle

explanation: Modern high-speed compression ignition (diesel) engines operate on the Dual (Sabathé) combustion cycle, where fuel burning begins at constant volume and finishes at constant pressure.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Ignition quality of diesel fuel is expressed by :

options.A: Octane number
options.B: Calorific value
options.C: Cetane number

explanation: Cetane number measures the ignition readiness and delay period of a diesel fuel; higher cetane ratings ensure shorter ignition lag and smooth, knock-free combustion.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The unit of force in SI system is :

options.A: Kilogram
options.B: Watts
options.C: Dyne

explanation: In the SI system, the standard unit of force is the Newton (N), defined as the force required to accelerate 1 kg of mass by 1 m/s².

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Hooks law holds good upto :

options.A: Yield point
options.B: Limit of proportionality
options.C: Plastic limit

explanation: Hooke's law states that stress is directly proportional to strain up to the limit of proportionality on a material's stress-strain diagram.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In a tensile test on mild steel specimen the breaking stress as compared to ultimate tensile stress is :

options.A: more
options.B: less
options.C: equal

explanation: In a tensile test of mild steel, localized necking occurs after passing the ultimate tensile stress (UTS), causing the engineering breaking stress to be lower than the UTS.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: A material capable of absorbing large amount of energy before fracture is called :

options.A: Ductility
options.B: Malleability
options.C: Toughness

explanation: Toughness represents the overall mechanical capacity of a material to absorb energy and deform plastically up to the point of fracture without failing.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Brake shoe rivets are made of materials having following property of drawn into wire :

options.A: Toughness
options.B: Hardness
options.C: Ductile

explanation: Ductility is the property that allows metals (like brass, copper, or soft aluminium) to be drawn into wire and plastically headed into rivets without cracking.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Belt slip may occur due to :

options.A: Heavy load
options.B: Loose belt
options.C: Driving pulley too small

explanation: Belt slippage occurs when driving torque exceeds frictional adhesion, caused by heavy mechanical resistance, insufficient belt tension, or inadequate wrap on small pulleys.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Shape of wood ruff key is like :

options.A: Semi circle
options.B: Cylinder
options.C: Sphere

explanation: A Woodruff key is a semicircular disc of steel that fits into a matching curved slot milled into a shaft, capable of self-aligning with tapered hub keyways.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: During engine rebuilding the crank shaft should be checked for :

options.A: End play
options.B: Binding
options.C: Bearing clearance

explanation: Crankshaft reconditioning requires checking journal oil clearance with Plastigage, end-float (thrust clearance) with a dial indicator, and free rotation without binding.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Slow plastic deformation of materials under a constant stress is known as :

options.A: Creep
options.B: Fatigue
options.C: Endurance

explanation: Creep is the time-dependent, slow, progressive plastic deformation of materials subjected to continuous mechanical stress, accelerated at elevated temperatures.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Unique property of cast iron is its high :

options.A: Malleability
options.B: Damping characteristics
options.C: Surface finish

explanation: Grey cast iron possesses high vibration damping capacity due to internal graphite flake structures, effectively suppressing engine block noise and harshness.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: When considerable metal must be removed to eliminate the taper in a cylinder bore the operation is :

options.A: Bored
options.B: Honed
options.C: Ground

explanation: Cylinder boring cuts away significant amounts of distorted metal with a rigid boring bar to correct bore taper and out-of-roundness before light finish honing.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: When you are boring cylinders the main bearing caps should be :

options.A: off
options.B: attached with specified bolt torque
options.C: lightly attached

explanation: Main bearing cap bolts produce significant structural stress in the block; torquing them to exact specification during cylinder machining prevents bore distortion after assembly.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The purpose of gear on some camshaft is :

options.A: Drive the gear train
options.B: Time the gear
options.C: Drive the fan belt

explanation: In OHV and classic engines, an integral spiral gear on the camshaft drives the ignition distributor and the engine oil pump shaft.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: When valve face angle is ground one degree less than the seat angle it is called :

options.A: Sloppy Workmanship
options.B: Completion Angle
options.C: Interference angle

explanation: An interference angle (e.g. 44° valve face against a 45° seat) concentrates sealing pressure into a narrow line to crush carbon deposits and ensure a positive gas seal.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Distance time force is equal to :

options.A: Work
options.B: Torque
options.C: Power

explanation: In physics, mechanical Work is defined as the product of Force multiplied by Distance moved in the direction of the force ($Work = Force \times Distance$).

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The ability to do work is :

options.A: Torque
options.B: Energy
options.C: Power

explanation: Energy is defined as the capacity or ability of a physical body or system to perform work.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In rotary distributor type diesel pump, injection timing is controlled by :

options.A: Speed with which plunger move
options.B: Cam shaft movement
options.C: Movement of the cam ring

explanation: In distributor-type fuel injection pumps (like Bosch VE), hydraulic transfer pressure acts against an advance piston that rotates the stationary cam ring to advance or retard injection timing.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The purpose of crank case ventilation is :

options.A: Remove sludge and sediments
options.B: Supply oxygen to crank case
options.C: Remove oxygen from crank case

explanation: Crankcase ventilation (PCV) circulates filtered air through the crankcase to purge water moisture and unburned fuel vapors before they condense and contaminate engine oil.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Most of the dilution of oil in crank case takes place during :

options.A: High speed operation
options.B: Long Trips
options.C: Engine overheating

explanation: During short trips, the engine does not reach normal operating temperature, preventing fuel condensates and moisture from boiling off from the crankcase oil.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Two valves in pressure cap are :

options.A: Pressure valve and blow by valve
options.B: Atmospheric valve and vacuum valve
options.C: Pressure valve and vacuum valve

explanation: A radiator pressure cap contains a spring-loaded pressure relief valve to elevate coolant boiling point and a vacuum relief valve to prevent hose collapse as the engine cools.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The strength of antifreeze solution in the cooling system is checked by a special type of :

options.A: Micrometer
options.B: Hydrometer
options.C: Barometer

explanation: An optical or float-type hydrometer measures the specific gravity of the coolant solution to determine the concentration of ethylene glycol and freeze protection rating.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The boiling of the coolant after turning off the engine is called :

options.A: After Boil
options.B: Over heating
options.C: Hard Running

explanation: After-boil is the localized boiling of coolant immediately after engine shutdown, caused by residual combustion chamber heat soaking into stagnant coolant.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Accumulation of rust and scale in the engine cooling system results in :

options.A: Slow warm up
options.B: Reduce heating capacity
options.C: Over heating

explanation: Rust and mineral scale act as thermal insulators that clog radiator tubes and restrict heat transfer from cylinder walls, causing the engine to overheat.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Ohms law is :

options.A: I = VR
options.B: R = AI
options.C: V = RC

explanation: Ohm's law defines the relationship between potential difference ($V$), current ($I$), and electrical resistance ($R$) as $V = I \times R$.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Why Automobile wiring is called one wiring system ?

options.A: Battery is having one positive and one negative terminal
options.B: Body, frame and engine furnish the return circuit
options.C: Alternator charges only in one direction

explanation: In automotive earth-return (single-wire) systems, a single insulated positive cable feeds each electrical accessory while the conductive steel chassis, body, and engine serve as the ground return circuit.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In first angle projection method an object is said to be :

options.A: Above HP infront of VP
options.B: Below HP infront of VP
options.C: Above HP Behind VP

explanation: In first angle engineering projection, the object is positioned in the first quadrant: above the Horizontal Plane (HP) and in front of the Vertical Plane (VP).

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Black smoky exhaust is due to :

options.A: Worn piston rings
options.B: Excessively rich mixture
options.C: In correct size spark plug

explanation: Black exhaust smoke is composed of unburned carbon soot resulting from an excessively rich air-fuel mixture or restricted air filtration.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Valve springs are checked for :

options.A: Tension
options.B: Squareness
options.C: Installed Height

explanation: Valve spring testing involves verifying spring tension at specified heights with a spring tester, checking free height, and measuring perpendicular squareness against a machinist's square.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Courtesy light in the car is switched on :

options.A: When doors are opened
options.B: When brake is applied
options.C: When indicator switch is on
options.D: When park light switch is on

explanation: Courtesy (interior dome) lights are illuminated automatically via door-jamb ground switches whenever any vehicle door is opened.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Dwell period is :

options.A: Time period required to recharge a battery
options.B: Period during which the distributor CB points remain open
options.C: Period during which the distributor CB points remain closed

explanation: Dwell period (dwell angle) is the duration measured in distributor degrees during which the contact breaker points remain closed to magnetically saturate the primary ignition coil.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Inclination of tyre from vertical is called :

options.A: Caster
options.B: Camber
options.C: Toe in

explanation: Camber is the inward or outward tilt of the front road wheels away from the true vertical axis as viewed from the front of the vehicle.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In Hotch kiss drive torque reaction is taken by :

options.A: Torque tube
options.B: Propeller shaft
options.C: Universal Joint

explanation: In a Hotchkiss drive layout, driving thrust, braking torque, and axle torque reactions are absorbed through the flexing of the rear semi-elliptical leaf springs.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Naturally aspirated engine uses :

options.A: Super charger
options.B: Simple carburettor
options.C: Booster pump

explanation: Naturally aspirated engines draw air and fuel (via simple carburetor or manifold vacuum) solely through atmospheric pressure without forced induction turbochargers or superchargers.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In an over square engine :

options.A: Piston stroke is less than cylinder diameter
options.B: Stroke is equal to bore
options.C: Bore is less than stroke

explanation: An oversquare (short-stroke) engine has a piston stroke that is shorter than its cylinder bore diameter (Stroke < Bore), enabling higher engine RPM with lower piston speeds.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Find the odd one :

options.A: Odometer
options.B: Tachometer
options.C: Hydrometer

explanation: Odometer, tachometer, and speedometer are automotive mechanical/electrical motion gauges, whereas a hydrometer is a chemical density instrument used for testing battery electrolyte or coolant.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Tetrahedron is a solid having :

options.A: Three equilateral triangular faces
options.B: Six equilateral triangular faces
options.C: Four equilateral triangular faces and a square base

explanation: A regular tetrahedron is a geometric solid polyhedron bounded by four congruent equilateral triangular faces.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Normal cranking speed for starting a diesel engine is atleast :

options.A: 100 rpm cold 110 rpm hot
options.B: 240 rpm cold 480 rpm hot
options.C: 100 rpm cold 240 rpm hot

explanation: A diesel engine requires a minimum cranking speed of roughly 100 RPM when cold and 240 RPM when hot to develop sufficient compression heat to self-ignite injected diesel fuel.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: To make clutch engagement smooth friction disk is fitted with :

options.A: Cushion pads
options.B: Cushion springs
options.C: Cushion bolts

explanation: Wavy marcel cushion springs riveted between the clutch friction facings compress progressively as the pressure plate engages, ensuring smooth and gradual power transmission.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Clutch slippage is noticeable when :

options.A: During acceleration
options.B: During idle
options.C: While starting the engine

explanation: Clutch slipping is most obvious during heavy acceleration under load, where engine RPM spikes upward without a corresponding increase in vehicle road speed.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Caution about asbestos dust in clutch facing is that :

options.A: It make you sneeze
options.B: Causes eye irritation
options.C: Damage the pressure plate

explanation: Inhaling microscopic airborne asbestos dust fibers from worn clutch facings is a known cause of asbestosis, lung cancer, and malignant mesothelioma.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Hard shifting into gear may be caused by :

options.A: Gear shift linkage out of adjustment
options.B: Clutch not disengaging
options.C: Excessive clutch free pedal play

explanation: Difficult gear shifting can result from misaligned shift linkages, a dragging clutch that does not fully disengage, or excessive pedal free-play preventing complete release.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The purpose of skid plate is :

options.A: Protect transfer case from rocks hitting
options.B: Prevent vehicle from skidding
options.C: Support the transfer case

explanation: A skid plate is a reinforced protective steel/aluminium shield mounted beneath the vehicle to shield transfer cases, transmission, and oil pans from road debris and rock impacts.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: In automatic transmission a band is applied by :

options.A: An accumulator
options.B: A clutch
options.C: A servo

explanation: In an automatic transmission, flexible steel brake bands are clamped around planetary gear drums by hydraulic piston servos.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Two controlling devices in an automatic transmission operated by hydraulic pressure are bands and :

options.A: Piston
options.B: Clutches
options.C: Gears

explanation: Automatic transmissions use hydraulic fluid pressure directed to servos (which operate brake bands) and hydraulic pistons (which engage multi-plate clutch packs) to select gear ratios.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The purpose of universal joint is :

options.A: Change drive shaft length
options.B: Support the shaft at middle
options.C: Drive angle to change
options.D: Shaft to be removed and installed easily

explanation: A universal joint (Cardan joint) allows the propeller shaft to transmit rotational torque continuously while accommodating angular variations caused by rear suspension travel.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: The distance between adjacent meshing teeth of mating gears is called :

options.A: Clearance
options.B: Pitch line
options.C: Flank

explanation: Backlash (referred to as back ish) is the clearance or play between mating gear teeth at the pitch circle, providing space for lubricating oil films and thermal tooth expansion.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: A front stabilizer bar is used to :

options.A: Control suspension movement and body roll
options.B: Increase load carrying capacity
options.C: Provide soft ride

explanation: A front stabilizer bar (sway bar) connects opposite suspension control arms via a transverse torsion bar to minimize vehicle body lean and roll during cornering.

subject: AUTOMOBILE
question: Camber angle plus SAI is called :

options.A: Caster
options.B: Included angle
options.C: Point of intersection

explanation: In wheel alignment, the Included Angle is the total geometric angle formed between the steering axis (Steering Axis Inclination - SAI) and the wheel center line: Included Angle = SAI + Camber.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: The process of body repairing and refinishing in automobile is termed :

options.A: De-coking
options.B: Denting
options.C: De - greasing

explanation: Denting is the sheet metal bodywork repair process of hammering, pulling, reshaping, and eliminating surface dents and body deformities before filling, priming, and paint refinishing.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... type jack can be moved on wheels.

options.A: Trolley
options.B: Differential screw
options.C: Bottle

explanation: A hydraulic trolley jack is equipped with wheels/castor rollers and a long operating lever, enabling mechanics to easily roll and position it under vehicle chassis lift points.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... is used to remove and install piston rings on piston.

options.A: Piston ring compressor
options.B: Piston ring groove cleaner
options.C: Piston skirt expander

explanation: A piston ring expander is a specialized plier tool used to safely expand and spread piston rings over the piston crown for removal or installation without breaking them.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... are used to remove gears, bearings pulleys etc. from their attaching components.

options.A: Cranes
options.B: Pullers
options.C: Hydraulic lifts

explanation: Mechanical or hydraulic pullers use adjustable grip jaws and a central threaded forcing screw to extract press-fit gears, pulleys, and bearings from shafts without component damage.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: The reason for oil warning lamp lighting on while vehicle is cornering is :

options.A: Low oil level
options.B: Broken fan belt
options.C: Thermostat defective

explanation: When engine oil level is dangerously low, centrifugal cornering forces push the oil to one side of the sump, starving the oil pump pickup tube of oil and triggering the low oil pressure warning lamp.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Calls is associated with ......

options.A: Conductor licencing
options.B: Registration certificate
options.C: Certificate of fitness

explanation: Under Stage Carriage Rules and Motor Vehicles regulations, calling upon passengers for stops/fares and managing passenger calls is a statutory duty associated with Conductor licensing.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Validity for taxi permit for a vehicle is ......

options.A: 20 years
options.B: 5 years
options.C: 15 years

explanation: Under Section 81 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988, a transport vehicle permit (including contract carriage/taxi permit) is valid for a period of 5 years from the date of issuance.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: For obtaining driving licence for a transport vehicle the person should have completed ...... of age.

options.A: 16 years
options.B: 50 years
options.C: 18 years

explanation: According to Section 4(2) of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988, no person under the age of 20 years shall drive or hold a driving licence to drive a transport vehicle in any public place.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: The road in which vehicle should not be driven in reverse direction is

options.A: zig zag road
options.B: one way road
options.C: channelised road

explanation: Under standard Road Regulations (Rules of the Road), driving a vehicle in the reverse direction on a designated one-way road is strictly prohibited to prevent head-on collisions.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Maximum speed limit fixed by Kerala state government for light motor vehicle to be driven in the state highway is ......

options.A: 50 kmph
options.B: 40 kmph
options.C: 70 kmph

explanation: Under traditional state highway speed limit notifications for Light Motor Vehicles (LMVs) in Kerala, the maximum permitted speed limit was fixed at 70 kmph.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Mandatory signs are also known as ............

options.A: Regulatory signs
options.B: Cautionary signs
options.C: Informatory signs

explanation: Mandatory road traffic signs are circular signs that indicate statutory laws, restrictions, and orders that must be obeyed, and are therefore also designated as Regulatory signs.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: No motor vehicle when towing another vehicle other than a trailer or side car shall be driven at a speed exceeding ...... kilometers per hour
explanation: Under Central Motor Vehicle Rules (Rules of the Road Regulations), no motor vehicle towing another disabled motor vehicle (other than a trailer or sidecar) shall exceed 25 kmph.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: After the expiry of a period of 1 year from the date on which the motor vehicle was first registered every vehicle shall carry a pollution under control certificate valid for ......

options.A: 6 months
options.B: 5 years
options.C: 1 year

explanation: After the initial 1-year registration period of a new vehicle, every vehicle must undergo periodic emission testing and carry a Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate valid for 6 months.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... is a licence issued by state or Regional Transport Authority authorizing the use of a vehicle as a transport vehicle.

options.A: Certificate of fitness
options.B: Registration certificate
options.C: Driving licence

explanation: Under Section 2(31) of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988, a 'Permit' is the statutory document granted by a State or Regional Transport Authority authorising the use of a motor vehicle as a transport vehicle.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: A private motor vehicle has a period of ..... validity for its registration.

options.A: 10 years
options.B: 15 years
options.C: 5 years

explanation: Under Section 41(7) of the Motor Vehicles Act, the initial Certificate of Registration issued for a private (non-transport) motor vehicle is valid for a period of 15 years.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Section ...... of motor vehicle act deals with offence of not having valid insurance
explanation: Section 146 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 makes third-party insurance compulsory for all motor vehicles operating in a public place (with driving without insurance penalised under Section 196).

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Unladen weight of a motor car or tractor or road roller which does not exceed ..... kgs. is classified as light motor vehicle.
explanation: Under Section 2(21) of the Motor Vehicles Act, a Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) means a transport vehicle or omnibus whose gross vehicle weight, or a car/tractor/roller whose unladen weight does not exceed 7,500 kg.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Validity of commercial driving licence for transport vehicle is ..... after which it is renewed.

options.A: 8 years
options.B: 5 years
options.C: 1 year

explanation: Under Section 14(2)(a) of the MV Act 1988 (prior to 2019 amendment), a commercial driving licence for driving a transport vehicle was valid for 3 years before requiring renewal (amended to 5 years in 2019).

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Conductor's licence has to be obtained by conductor of a ......

options.A: Contract carriage
options.B: Articulated vehicle
options.C: Private service vehicle

explanation: Under Chapter III of the Motor Vehicles Act, only public service vehicles operating as a Stage Carriage (passenger buses) legally require a qualified person holding a Conductor's licence.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: M.A.C.T. is related with

options.A: warranty agreement
options.B: third party claims
options.C: fleet maintenance

explanation: The Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (M.A.C.T.) was constituted under the Motor Vehicles Act to adjudicate claims for compensation and third-party insurance liability arising from motor vehicle accidents.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ..... are usually unloaded by means of hydraulic hoists.

options.A: Dump trucks
options.B: Crawler tractors
options.C: Articulated vehicles

explanation: Dump trucks (tippers) are heavy commercial vehicles equipped with a hydraulic hoist ram mechanism that tilts the cargo bed rearward or sideways to dump bulk materials rapidly.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Four wheel drive arrangement is inclusive of a ......

options.A: trailer
options.B: fifth Wheel
options.C: dummy axle

explanation: In four-wheel drive (4WD/4x4) vehicles, a transfer case/box mounted behind the gearbox splits drive torque between the front and rear propeller shafts and provides 2H/4H/4L drive ranges.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... indicates eight wheel locations of which four are for driving wheels.

options.A: 6 \times 4
options.B: 8 \times 4
options.C: 4 \times 2

explanation: In standard vehicle wheel formula notation (Total Wheels x Driven Wheels), '8 x 4' signifies a commercial vehicle with 8 wheel hub locations of which 4 are driving wheels.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Top of the engine block where the cylinder head mounts is called .....

options.A: Crankcase
options.B: Manifold
options.C: Valve cover

explanation: The top flat, precision-machined mating surface of the engine cylinder block onto which the cylinder head and head gasket are torqued down is called the engine block deck.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: A short block does not include .......

options.A: Cylinder head
options.B: Camshaft
options.C: Cylinder block

explanation: An automotive 'short block' subassembly includes the cylinder block, crankshaft, connecting rods, and pistons, but excludes the cylinder head, valvetrain, camshaft, and manifolds.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... type of vehicle is generally classified as a 2 door front seating van with an open back to carry mixed collection of goods.

options.A: Estate car
options.B: Convertible
options.C: Pickup

explanation: A pickup truck is classified as a light commercial vehicle with a 2-door or 4-door passenger cab at the front and an open cargo bed with low sides and a tailgate at the rear.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In two stroke petrol engine during each cycle of operation, piston stroke corresponds to ....... of the crankshaft.

options.A: 90^\circ
options.B: 180^\circ
options.C: 270^\circ

explanation: In any reciprocating engine (two-stroke or four-stroke), each individual piston stroke from TDC to BDC corresponds to exactly 180 degrees of crankshaft rotation.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In an engine ..... takes the pressure of expanding gases and converts the rectilinear reciprocating motion of piston into rotary motion of crankshaft.

options.A: valve gear
options.B: running gear
options.C: crank gear

explanation: The engine's running gear (slider-crank mechanism of piston, gudgeon pin, connecting rod, and crankshaft) receives gas expansion forces and converts linear reciprocating motion into shaft torque.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... changes torque and transmits it from the propeller shaft through the differential to drive axle shafts

options.A: Final drive
options.B: Flywheel
options.C: Clutch

explanation: The final drive (bevel pinion and crown wheel) provides permanent gear reduction to increase torque and turns the axis of rotation by 90 degrees to transmit power to the drive axle shafts.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ....... in the crankshaft carries big end of connecting rods linked to the piston.

options.A: Crank journal
options.B: Crank pin
options.C: Main bearing

explanation: The crank pin (connecting rod journal) is the offset cylindrical journal on the crankshaft that carries the big-end bearing of the connecting rod linked to the piston.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In ...... type of muffler the direction of exhaust gases changed many times, so it can travel long path, while expansion is taking place.

options.A: Absorption
options.B: Straight through
options.C: Baffle

explanation: Baffle-type mufflers contain multiple internal perforated plates and partition walls that force exhaust gases to reverse direction repeatedly along a tortuous path, dissipating sound pressure.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: To prepare a rich mixture required for starting a cold engine, carburettors have a ..... with an automatic flap.

options.A: choke valve
options.B: accelerator pump
options.C: emulsion tube

explanation: The choke valve is a butterfly valve situated upstream of the carburettor venturi that restricts airflow, creating high vacuum to draw extra fuel and produce the rich air-fuel mixture needed for cold starting.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In case of diesel multi hole Nozzles, the dead volume between the Nozzle seat and the end of the spray hole is called ...... volume.

options.A: delivery
options.B: nozzle
options.C: sac

explanation: In multi-hole diesel fuel injection nozzles, the tiny dead volume remaining between the needle valve seat and the orifice spray holes is called the sac volume (minimised to limit HC emissions).

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... in the conventional plunger type fuel injection pump in diesel fuel system, acts as an anti dribble device.

options.A: Bleed screw
options.B: Delivery valve
options.C: Control rack

explanation: The delivery valve in a jerk-type diesel injection pump features a relief/retraction piston collar that withdraws a small volume of fuel from the delivery line at cut-off, snapping the nozzle needle shut without dribble.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: S.U. Carburettor is an example of ...... type of carburettor.

options.A: Constant choke
options.B: Vane venturi
options.C: Nozzle bar venturi

explanation: The S.U. (Skinners Union) carburettor is a classic variable-venturi (constant-depression) carburettor where a vacuum-operated air piston automatically adjusts the venturi area and metering needle.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Agglomerator functions as diesel ......

options.A: injector
options.B: feed pump
options.C: governor

explanation: An agglomerator in a diesel fuel system functions as a fuel filter and water separator, causing microscopic suspended water droplets to coalesce into larger drops that settle out of the diesel fuel.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... is a device to relieve the vapour pressure developing in carburettor due to vapourisation of fuel in hot weather.

options.A: Anti percolator
options.B: Metering valve
options.C: Bistarter

explanation: An anti-percolator is a valve in the carburettor float bowl that vents excessive fuel vapor pressure during hot idle or soak conditions, preventing boiled fuel from expanding into the manifold.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: A blue smoky exhaust indicates ...... in engine.

options.A: over rich mixture
options.B: lean mixture
options.C: leaking coolant

explanation: Blue or blue-grey smoke emitted from the vehicle exhaust indicates that engine lubricating oil is entering the combustion chamber (via worn piston rings or valve stem oil seals) and burning.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Escape of burned gases from combustion chamber past piston and into the crankcase is called ......

options.A: scavenging
options.B: blow by
options.C: flushing

explanation: Blow-by is the leakage of high-pressure combustion and exhaust gases from the combustion chamber past worn or unseated piston rings into the lower crankcase.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Punctured float in carburettor leads to ..... of carburettor.

options.A: icing
options.B: percolation
options.C: popping back

explanation: A punctured carburettor float fills with petrol, loses buoyancy, and sinks, holding the needle valve permanently open and resulting in continuous fuel overflow and flooding of the carburettor.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Octane number of C.N.G. is around .....
explanation: Compressed Natural Gas (CNG, primarily methane) has an extremely high research octane number (RON) of approximately 120, making it exceptionally resistant to engine knocking.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In ..... system the blow by gases are re routed back into the intake manifold or inlet of carburettor

options.A: E.L.C.D.
options.B: P.C.V.
options.C: A.I.S.

explanation: The Positive Crankcase Ventilation (PCV) system draws combustible crankcase blow-by fumes through a one-way PCV valve back into the engine intake manifold to be burned cleanly.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In diesel fuel system ..... controls automatically the supply of fuel in accordance with the engine load.

options.A: delivery valve
options.B: fuel injector
options.C: governor

explanation: In diesel fuel injection systems, the governor automatically senses engine speed and adjusts the fuel injection pump control rack to meter fuel delivery in accordance with changing engine loads.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: EGR system is used to reduce the amount of ..... in the exhaust.

options.A: \text{NO}_\text{x}
options.B: UBHC
options.C: \text{CO}_2

explanation: Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) meters an inert fraction of exhaust gas into the intake airflow, lowering peak combustion flame temperatures below 1800 K to inhibit thermal NOx formation.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ....... in diesel fuel system uses a combined injection pump and Nozzle for each cylinder.

options.A: Inline pump
options.B: Crdi
options.C: Unit injector

explanation: A Unit Injector (EUI / Pumpe-Duse) integrates the high-pressure fuel pumping plunger and the multi-hole injection nozzle into a single compact unit mounted directly over each cylinder.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Heavy commercial vehicles such as trucks, buses etc.. employ ..... wheels.

options.A: Integral type rim
options.B: Fiat base rim
options.C: Drop centre type rim

explanation: Heavy commercial vehicles (trucks and buses) employ flat base rims with detachable side rings and split locking rings to mount stiff, heavy-duty multi-ply commercial tyres.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Outer part of pressed steel disc wheel is called .....

options.A: hub
options.B: flange
options.C: rim

explanation: A pressed steel disc wheel consists of an inner pressed circular mounting disc (spider) permanently welded inside an outer rolled steel cylindrical rim that seats the tyre beads.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Aspect ratio employed in passenger cars are around .....
explanation: Standard passenger cars commonly use tyres with an aspect ratio of around 70% (e.g. 70 series, 145/70 or 155/70), providing a balance of compliance, comfort, and sidewall stability.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In the example for radial type designation 145/70 \text{ SR } 12, 12 indicates ....

options.A: Rim diameter in inches
options.B: Ply rating
options.C: Aspect ratio of tyre
options.D: Cross sectional width of tyre in mm.

explanation: In radial tyre designation 145/70 SR 12: 145 is section width in mm, 70 is aspect ratio, S is speed rating, R denotes radial construction, and 12 indicates wheel rim diameter in inches.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Flat frame is another name for .......... frame.

options.A: tubular
options.B: double cradle
options.C: backbone

explanation: A ladder chassis frame consists of two long longitudinal channel/box side members joined by multiple transverse cross members, creating a planar flat structure resembling a ladder.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In ..... tyres orientation of ply cords is along the tyre axis.

options.A: Cross ply
options.B: Radial
options.C: Bias belted

explanation: In radial ply tyres, the fabric or steel casing cords run radially from bead to bead across the tyre axis at approximately 90 degrees to the circumference.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... angle is also known as wheel rake.

options.A: Included
options.B: King pin
options.C: Caster

explanation: Caster angle (the forward or rearward inclination of the steering kingpin or strut axis from the vertical) is historically referred to in wheel alignment terminology as wheel rake.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Canti-lever leaf spring is also known as ......

options.A: Quarter elliptic leaf spring
options.B: Taperlite spring
options.C: Semi elliptic inverted leaf spring

explanation: A quarter-elliptic leaf spring is clamped solidly to the chassis frame at one end while the projecting end supports the axle like a cantilever beam, and is thus known as a cantilever spring.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Only a single wishbone arm is used in the construction of .....

options.A: Trailing link suspension
options.B: Wishbone type ifs
options.C: Mac pherson strut type ifs
options.D: Combination of coiled and air springs.

explanation: MacPherson strut independent front suspension (IFS) uses a single lower wishbone (or track control arm) paired with an upper telescopic damper strut fastened to the vehicle inner wing.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: ...... is done to equalize and distribute the tyre wear as well as to obtain maximum tyre life.

options.A: Tyre retreading
options.B: Tyre rotation
options.C: Vulcanizing

explanation: Tyre rotation is the systematic periodic relocation of tyres between front and rear or cross axles to ensure even tread wear across all tyres and achieve maximum tyre service life.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: To reduce effective clamping load on the carbon thrust bearing and wear on it, a clutch should be provided ......

options.A: Free pedal play
options.B: End play
options.C: Back lash

explanation: Free pedal play ensures a small running gap between the clutch release bearing (carbon or ball thrust) and the release levers when the pedal is released, preventing continuous rubbing and wear.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: In ....., the spring itself acts as release levers.

options.A: Centrifugal clutch
options.B: Cone clutch
options.C: Diaphragm clutch

explanation: In a diaphragm spring clutch, the central conical steel spring has tapered radial fingers that flex inward when depressed by the release bearing, functioning directly as release levers.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Manually operated selective transmission is also known as .....

options.A: Stick shift
options.B: Overdrive
options.C: Semi automatic

explanation: A manual selective sliding/synchromesh gearbox controlled by a manual clutch pedal and gearshift lever is commonly and technically known as a stick shift transmission.

subject: DRIVER-MECHANIC
question: Weak spring of fork rod in gear selector mechanism will cause .....

options.A: Oil leak
options.B: Hard gear shifting
